longName: Produce the Annual IDEA Part B Child Count Data File
scope: The SEA's process of producing the FS002 data file: extract, LEA aggregation, categorization, file-spec conformance, pre-EDPass validation. Out of scope: EDPass upload (parent); FS5003/FS5002 authoring.
frequency: Annually, per SEA, between the count date (Oct-Dec) and ~April 1.

actors.actor: SEA IDEA Part B Data Manager
actors.interest: A clean, reproducible, audit-ready file with lead time.

actors.role: Sponsors the cycle; receives the compiled file.
actors.interest: A clean validated file with lead time.

actors.role: Executes the extract; returns the per-student dataset.

actors.interest: Catch at source what would surface mid-submission.

triggeredBy.name: The SEA authorizes the annual IDEA Part B data collection cycle

assumes.statement: The state's designated IDEA Part B child count date falls between October 1 and December 1, and every record in the count reflects the child's placement on that date.
The current FS002 file-spec version is published and available to the SEA.
The SEA has a working SLDS, state IDEA data system, or LEA-aggregation process.
The state's FS5003 collection-methodology responses exist in at least draft form before FS002 compilation begins.

story.action: confirms the current FS002 file-spec version and notes changes from the prior cycle
story.intention: breaking spec changes are surfaced before work

story.action: confirms the SEA's state-selected child-count date (Oct 1 - Dec 1)
story.intention: all aggregations anchor to the right date

story.action: initiates the SLDS/IDEA-system extract for the eligible population (unduplicated IDEA Part B children, ages 5-in-K through 21, active IEPs on the count date)
returns one record per eligible student across the source elements

consumes.role: IDEA Educational Environment for School Age
IDEA Educational Environment for Early Childhood

story.action: where aggregating from LEAs, reconciles cross-LEA student deduplication per the SEA's documented rule
applies the SEA's categorization rules to compute the FS002 categorical dimensions (Age, Disability Category, Educational Environment, Race/Ethnicity, EL, state-operated-programs flag)
story.intention: every child lands in correct categories

consumes.role: IDEA Educational Environment School Age (governed by FS5003)

story.action: computes SEA-, LEA-, and school-level aggregations (Category Sets A-E, Subtotals 1-7, Total), including zero-count records
story.intention: the federal aggregate structure is complete

produces.role: Computed FS002 aggregations (Category Sets A-E, subtotals, totals)

story.action: applies the FS002 file format and produces the file with the required naming convention

consumes.role: Aggregations formatted into the FS002 file

story.action: runs SEA-internal pre-EDPass validation (format, permitted values, missing-data encoding, zero-count completeness, likely-BRSI heuristics)
story.benefit: BRSI-style errors are caught at the SEA with time to fix, not mid-submission

story.action: records compilation provenance in the audit trail (extract version/date, methodology config, dedup outcomes, anticipated data notes)
story.intention: every number is reproducible and defensible

story.action: marks the file Ready-to-Upload and hands it to the EDFacts Coordinator
story.intention: the parent case has a clean input

scenario.condition: the extract fails or returns incomplete data

story.action: works with the SLDS Administrator to diagnose, reschedules/remediates, resumes at step 3

scenario.condition: per-student source data has missing/ambiguous values

story.action: flags affected records, resolves via the LEA Data Steward or codes as MISSING per spec, resumes at step 4

scenario.condition: a classification/environment does not fit one permitted value per the FS5003 methodology

story.action: applies the documented classification rule and records it for later data-note authoring in the parent

scenario.condition: pre-EDPass validation surfaces format or business-rule failures

story.action: corrects source data and re-aggregates (returns to step 4 or 6), or records a known limitation for a data note in the parent
story.intention: the file is clean or its limitation is documented

condition.statement: The FS002 data file exists, conforms to the current file-spec version, and has passed all SEA-internal pre-EDPass validation.
The file is Ready-to-Upload for the parent submission case.
No child is counted more than once in the FS002 file; each counted child appears in exactly one educational environment category as of the count date.
Every reported figure is traceable through a retained audit trail to the source records and the transformations that produced it.

comprises.role: IDEA Educational Environment for School Age
IDEA Educational Environment for Early Childhood

relatedUseCases.notes: produces the methodology governing the environment dimension computed in step 6
